# fmc_device_dhcp_server (Data Source)

This data source reads the Device DHCP Server.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_device_dhcp_server" "example" {
  id        = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  device_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Id of the parent device.
- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain

### Read-Only

- `auto_config_interface_id` (String) Id of the interface to be used for autoconfiguration. Id, name, and type must all be specified together.
- `auto_config_interface_name` (String) Name of the interface to be used for autoconfiguration. Id, name, and type must all be specified together.
- `auto_config_interface_type` (String) Type of the interface to be used for autoconfiguration. Id, name, and type must all be specified together.
- `dhcp_options` (Attributes List) List of advanced DHCP option codes (parameters) sent to DHCP clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dhcp_options))
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name given to DHCP clients.
- `lease_length` (Number) Duration (in seconds) that a client can use an assigned IP address before it must renew the lease.
- `ping_timeout` (Number) Ping timeout in milliseconds.
- `primary_dns_server_id` (String) Id of the Host object used as the primary DNS server offered to DHCP clients.
- `primary_wins_server_id` (String) Id of the Host object used as the primary WINS server offered to DHCP clients.
- `secondary_dns_server_id` (String) Id of the Host object used as the secondary DNS server offered to DHCP clients.
- `secondary_wins_server_id` (String) Id of the Host object used as the secondary WINS server offered to DHCP clients.
- `servers` (Attributes List) List of per-interface DHCP server pools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'DHCPServerSettings'.

<a id="nestedatt--dhcp_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dhcp_options`

Read-Only:

- `ascii` (String) ASCII value, when `type` is `ASCII`.
- `code` (Number) DHCP option code.
- `first_ip_address_id` (String) Id of the Host object used as the first IP address, when `type` is `IP`.
- `hex` (String) Hexadecimal value, when `type` is `HEX`.
- `second_ip_address_id` (String) Id of the Host object used as the second IP address, when `type` is `IP`.
- `type` (String) Type of the value carried by the option. `IP` uses `first_ip_address_id` (and optionally `second_ip_address_id`), `ASCII` uses `ascii` and `HEX` uses `hex`.


<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `address_pool` (String) Range of IP addresses (formatted as `start_ip-end_ip`) the DHCP server can hand out. The pool must be on the same subnet as the associated interface.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the DHCP server on the associated interface.
- `interface_id` (String) Id of the interface on which the DHCP server is enabled.
- `interface_name` (String) Name of the interface on which the DHCP server is enabled.
- `interface_type` (String) Type of the interface on which the DHCP server is enabled.
